traps: NAT Gateway has two mutually exclusive field sets, make sure to confirm with the user to either use 'Regional NAT Gateway' or 'NAT Gateway'. Regional (regionalNatGatewayCount, regionalNatGatewayAzCount, regionalNatGatewayDataProcessed) is the current UI default. Non-regional/legacy (numberOfGateways, dataProcessedPerNATGateway) also works. Using both will double-count costs.
Regional NAT Gateway is not available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud

All five fields are marked required by the manifest. When using one set, explicitly zero out the other — but the two sets aren't symmetric: numberOfGateways and dataProcessedPerNATGateway accept "0" (manifest minValue 0). regionalNatGatewayCount and regionalNatGatewayAzCount do NOT — the manifest enforces minValue: 1, so "0" is rejected ("value 0 is below minimum 1"). To zero out the regional set, use regionalNatGatewayCount: "1", regionalNatGatewayAzCount: "1", regionalNatGatewayDataProcessed: 0 (1/1/0 GB) — this adds no cost and matches this entry's own minimalConfig. There is no literal all-zero combination for the regional set.
Manifest defaults are 5 gateways × 3 AZs — wildly over-sized for a 'hello world'. minimalConfig overrides to 1×1; agents reading manifest defaults directly will over-estimate ~5×.
